 Follow Miss Universe 2026 hosts confirmed: Meet the star-studded lineup
 Shirley Gomez Tue, November 17, 2026 at 11:08 PM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. SAN SALVADOR, EL SALVADOR - NOVEMBER 18: Miss Universe 2022 R'Bonney Nola Gabriel speaks during the 72nd Miss Universe Competition at Gimnasio Nacional JosÃ© Adolfo Pineda on November 18, 2023 in San Salvador, El Salvador. (Photo by Hector Vivas/Getty Images) (Getty Images) The countdown to Miss Universe 2026 just got more exciting! The Miss Universe Organization has officially announced the hosts and presenters for its highly anticipated 75th anniversary celebration, and the lineup brings together familiar television personalities, former beauty queens, and an iconic pop star.
 Television host Mario Lopez and Miss Universe 2022 R'Bonney Gabriel have been confirmed as the main hosts of the Miss Universe 2026 grand finale, scheduled for November 24 at the Coliseo de Puerto Rico José Miguel Agrelot in San Juan, Puerto Rico.
 (@ Getty Images for Malibu Food & W)
 (@ Getty Images)
 The announcement, made on November 17, also confirms the participation of former Miss Universe winners Dayanara Torres , Denise Quiñones and Zuleyka Rivera , alongside television personality Zuri Hall  and NSYNC singer Lance Bass .

 With several former titleholders returning to the spotlight, the milestone edition promises a celebration of the pageant's history as much as a competition to crown its next winner.
 Who Are the Confirmed Miss Universe 2026 Hosts?
 According to the Miss Universe Organization 's announcement, Mario Lopez and R'Bonney Gabriel will lead the grand finale, while other personalities will take on commentary and hosting responsibilities throughout the celebration.

 Telemundo Also Confirms Its Miss Universe 2026 Broadcast Hosts
 Beyond the Miss Universe Organization's official presenting team, Telemundo has announced a separate lineup for its Spanish-language coverage.
 Mexican television personality Jacky Bracamontes and Puerto Rican presenter Carlos Adyan will lead the network's broadcast. They will be joined by Aleyda Ortiz and Clovis Nienow as co-hosts and commentators, while Jessica Carrillo will provide backstage coverage.
 Jacky Bracamontes will co-host Miss Universe (@ Getty Images)
 Telemundo's November 17 announcement also confirms additional pre-show programming, interviews and behind-the-scenes reporting from Puerto Rico. 
 When and Where Is Miss Universe 2026?
 Tuesday, November 24, 2026
 Coliseo de Puerto Rico José Miguel Agrelot, San Juan, Puerto Rico
 Telemundo and Peacock in the United States
 7 p.m. ET pre-show; 8 p.m. ET main broadcast on Telemundo
 Advertisement Advertisement Reigning Miss Universe 2025 Fátima Bosch of Mexico will crown her successor during the finale.
 Miss Universe delegates celebrating and congratulating 74th Miss Universe Fatima Bosch (@ Getty Images)
 Puerto Rico previously hosted Miss Universe in 1972, 2001 and 2002, making the 2026 event another major moment in the island's pageant history.
